label: Bible Study
prompt: Who shall _____ us from the love of Christ? shall tribulation, or distress, or persecution, or famine, or nakedness, or peril, or sword?
verse: Who shall separate us from the love of Christ? shall tribulation, or distress, or persecution, or famine, or nakedness, or peril, or sword?
note: Paul lists every threat he can think of — none can separate us from Christ's love.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: The blessing of the LORD, it maketh rich, and he addeth no _____ with it.
verse: The blessing of the LORD, it maketh rich, and he addeth no sorrow with it.
note: The LORD's blessing makes rich and adds no sorrow with it — no hidden fees.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And Moses stretched forth his rod over the land of Egypt, and the LORD brought an east wind upon the land all that day, and all that night; and when it was morning, the east wind brought the _____.
verse: And Moses stretched forth his rod over the land of Egypt, and the LORD brought an east wind upon the land all that day, and all that night; and when it was morning, the east wind brought the locusts.
note: An east wind all day and all night, and by morning the locusts arrived — then a west wind blew them into the Red Sea.

label: Deep Water
prompt: So they hanged Haman on the _____ that he had prepared for Mordecai. Then was the king's wrath pacified.
verse: So they hanged Haman on the gallows that he had prepared for Mordecai. Then was the king's wrath pacified.
note: Haman built a gallows for Mordecai — and the plot ran exactly in reverse.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: That by two _____ things, in which it was impossible for God to lie, we might have a strong consolation, who have fled for refuge to lay hold upon the hope set before us:
verse: That by two immutable things, in which it was impossible for God to lie, we might have a strong consolation, who have fled for refuge to lay hold upon the hope set before us:
note: God's promise plus his oath: 'two immutable things' — unchangeable — anchoring the hope set before us.
